timeout_scope: Each original mathematical child remains bounded by its original 60-second timeout. Canonical wrapper also declares 60 seconds; nonbaseline orchestration has 75 seconds but cannot extend a child. Independent reviewer controls and historical timeouts are archived, never rerun by this program.
success_classification: Continuum constant/rational gauge runs are positive controls; microscopic higher comparison and mixed refinement are comparisons; mut_wrong_origin_weighted is the actual complete author mutant survivor. Independent norm-only/sign and polarized-state survivors remain archived.
original_helper_preservation: All mathematical helper/candidate/fixture/reporting source bytes unchanged. Original administrative guard prefixes are replaced by declared pinned-resource verification; original guards and receipts are archived.
comparison: Full scientific stdout, stderr, result JSON and generated binary sidecars compare exactly. Only the literal unique candidate JSON token is relocated via the unchanged reporting Path.resolve(). For continuum-boost streams only, the single exact old pin-validation prefix is separated and retained; the complete mathematical stdout remains exact. No tolerance, version, platform, interpreter-field, value, whitespace or diagnostic normalization.
typed_api_order: Full INNER execute_runner object preserved first in opaque protocol5 pickle and tagged JSON before outer cache identity logic. Full OUTER tuple preserved first after return, then inspected. No pickle is loaded.
input_order: All direct declared scientific inputs finalized before canonical execution. Later preparation/validation archival maps and source identity manifest are not declared inputs. Any drift halts without an automatic retry.
refinement_input_scope: The two micro comparison helpers and mixed refinement helper read explicitly pinned original finite vectors/results. They test historical refinement payloads, not cross-run linkage to newly generated vectors. Fresh individual flow sidecars are preserved and compared in full to those exact originals.
audit_boundary: Source preparation is not a new science review or audit. Exact-base focused compatibility may inspect only existing selected ledger claims; actual covered rows are recorded. Global combined current-main validation, strict lint and independent audit remain landing work.
ownership: Root alone executes the frozen program in the clean exact target. Program does no Git/index/remote/PR mutations. Root handles exact-path staging and a regular dependent PR after reviewing actual results.
failure_rule: Stop, retain all partial outputs, receipt and source identities. No automatic scientific retry, fallback thresholds or cleanup of historical evidence.
pairing: Same selected model family and reasoning effort; separate reviewer contexts with formula exposure, not blinded or diverse-family. Root supplied routes and is a coauthor; the section note is root-authored. Mechanical preparation and reproduction add no independent scientific review.
